```{python}
import numpy as np

import transpose_invariance as tpi

import skimage as ski
import skimage.morphology as skm
```

See the analysis in `ai_output/gemini_skeletonize_invariance.md`.

```{python}
imgs = [img > ski.filters.threshold_mean(img)
        for img in tpi.get_3d_images()]
img = imgs[0]
```

```{python}
img.shape
```

```{python}
def func(img):
    return skm.skeletonize(img)

ws_orig = func(img)
```

```{python}
def check_func(img1, img2):
    assert np.allclose(img1, img2)
```

```{python}
ws_rolled = tpi.rolled_proc(img, (2, 1, 0), func)
check_func(ws_orig, ws_rolled)
```
